blocks.text: Accelerate Your Digital Transformation with Our Products and Services. Unlock Peak Performance!
Get started with intelligent integrations and powerful automation.

Discover the complete ecosystem of Jivrus products – from powerful form & document automation to intelligent app integrations, Google Workspace extensions, CRM connectors, and analytics tools.Our suite is built to simplify, automate, and scale your business.
awesomeness redefined with integration intelligence and hyper-automation
With intelligent integration and hyper-automation, business processes can be taken on auto-pilot mode for success.
We specialize in intelligent integration and hyper-automation with Applications, Products, Cloud, IoT and analytics to bring out the full potential of your business.
We research, conceive, produce, and maintain awesome software products worldwide to make customer business successful.
We are a technology partner with major platforms like Google, Microsoft, Zoho

A great app to generate a Google Doc from a form. We use it for testimonials and it works a treat. The students provides the data and the teachers can verify it by sharing with other staff. It saves so much time and energy, not more passing a form around!

"Amazing and affordable service! Great full stack options. Super swift support and they think with your case for possible features requests. After my request to Jivrus Technologies now they made Stripe automated invoicing and payment processing possible. Never experiences such a good software tool and support."
I have been using Form Director for years. I set it up so teachers in my school can easily send me announcements that my students read on our daily newscast in our school.

It is an easy way for teachers to send me the info they want read to the school. It saves me a ton of effort and once set, you can just let it do it's thing! I could not recommend it more highly. Great product!

This is a great product produced by a team of people that are responsive to their user base. I submitted a request for a addition to functionality that was answered promptly and implemented quickly. Highly recommend.

First time using this add-on. Very user friendly and easy to navigate. When I had an issue with Required fields Support was great! They fixed the problem and allowed my doc to function as needed. This is what Customer Service should be! Thank you!
Jan 2018 - Moved into Springboard office space
